description: A programmer-oriented testing framework for PHP.

option.name: --all
tip: Ignore the test selection from XML configuration file.

option.name: --atleast-version
tip: Check that the installed PHPUnit version is at least the given version, then exit.

option.name: --bootstrap
tip: A PHP script that is included before the tests run.

option.name: --branch-coverage
tip: Report branch coverage in addition to line coverage.

option.name: --cache-directory
tip: Specify the directory where PHPUnit stores data between test runs.

option.name: --cache-test-index
tip: Write test index to cache file.

option.name: --check-php-configuration
tip: Check whether the PHP configuration follows best practices for running PHPUnit.

option.name: --check-version
tip: Check whether the installed PHPUnit is the latest version, then exit.
Requires an internet connection.

option.name: --colors
tip: Use colors in output.
Possible values: never, auto, always.
Default: auto.
The value must be attached with =: --colors=never.

option.name: --columns
tip: Number of columns to use for progress output.
Use max for the terminal width.

option.name: --compact
tip: Replace the default progress and result output with compact format.

option.name: --composer-lock
tip: Print the composer.lock file used to build the PHAR, then exit.
Only available when PHPUnit runs from a PHAR.

option.name: --configuration
tip: Read configuration from an XML file.

option.name: --coverage-clover
tip: Write the code coverage report in Clover XML format to a file.

option.name: --coverage-cobertura
tip: Write the code coverage report in Cobertura XML format to a file.

option.name: --coverage-crap4j
tip: Write the code coverage report in Crap4J XML format to a file.

option.name: --coverage-filter
tip: Include <dir> in the code coverage report.

option.name: --coverage-html
tip: Write the code coverage report in HTML format to a directory.

option.name: --coverage-jsonl
tip: Write the code coverage report in JSONL format to a directory.

option.name: --coverage-openclover
tip: Write the code coverage report in OpenClover XML format to a file.

option.name: --coverage-php
tip: Write serialized code coverage data to a file.

option.name: --coverage-text
tip: Write the code coverage report in text format to a file.
Without a file, the report is written to standard output.
The value must be attached with =: --coverage-text=coverage.txt.

option.name: --coverage-xml
tip: Write the code coverage report in XML format to a directory.

option.name: --covers
tip: Only run tests that declare they intend to cover the given class or function.
Can be used multiple times.

option.name: --debug
tip: Replace the default progress and result output with debugging information.

option.name: --default-time-limit
tip: Timeout in seconds for tests that have no declared size.
Used together with --enforce-time-limit.

option.name: --diff-context
tip: Number of context lines shown around changes in diffs.
Default: 3.

option.name: --disable-coverage-ignore
tip: Disable metadata for ignoring code coverage.

option.name: --disable-coverage-targeting
tip: Disable metadata for code coverage targeting.

option.name: --disallow-test-output
tip: Be strict about output during tests.

option.name: --display-all-issues
tip: Display details for all issues that are triggered.

option.name: --display-deprecations
tip: Display details for deprecations triggered by tests.

option.name: --display-errors
tip: Display details for errors triggered by tests.

option.name: --display-incomplete
tip: Display details for incomplete tests.

option.name: --display-notices
tip: Display details for notices triggered by tests.

option.name: --display-phpunit-deprecations
tip: Display details for PHPUnit deprecations.

option.name: --display-phpunit-notices
tip: Display details for PHPUnit notices.

option.name: --display-skipped
tip: Display details for skipped tests.

option.name: --display-warnings
tip: Display details for warnings triggered by tests.

option.name: --do-not-cache-test-index
tip: Do not write test index to cache file.

option.name: --do-not-fail-on-deprecation
tip: Do not signal failure using shell exit code when a deprecation was triggered.

option.name: --do-not-fail-on-direct-deprecation
tip: Do not signal failure using shell exit code when a deprecation was triggered in third-party code called from first-party code.

option.name: --do-not-fail-on-empty-test-suite
tip: Do not signal failure using shell exit code when no tests were run.

option.name: --do-not-fail-on-incomplete
tip: Do not signal failure using shell exit code when a test was marked incomplete.

option.name: --do-not-fail-on-indirect-deprecation
tip: Do not signal failure using shell exit code when a deprecation was triggered in third-party code called from third-party code.

option.name: --do-not-fail-on-notice
tip: Do not signal failure using shell exit code when a notice was triggered.

option.name: --do-not-fail-on-phpunit-deprecation
tip: Do not signal failure using shell exit code when a PHPUnit deprecation was triggered.

option.name: --do-not-fail-on-phpunit-notice
tip: Do not signal failure using shell exit code when a PHPUnit notice was triggered.

option.name: --do-not-fail-on-phpunit-warning
tip: Do not signal failure using shell exit code when a PHPUnit warning was triggered.

option.name: --do-not-fail-on-risky
tip: Do not signal failure using shell exit code when a test was considered risky.

option.name: --do-not-fail-on-self-deprecation
tip: Do not signal failure using shell exit code when a deprecation was triggered in first-party code.

option.name: --do-not-fail-on-skipped
tip: Do not signal failure using shell exit code when a test was skipped.

option.name: --do-not-fail-on-warning
tip: Do not signal failure using shell exit code when a warning was triggered.

option.name: --do-not-record-test-run-history
tip: Do not record test run history.

option.name: --do-not-report-useless-tests
tip: Do not report tests that do not test anything.

option.name: --do-not-warn-when-php-is-not-configured-for-development
tip: Do not trigger a test runner warning when PHP is not configured for development.

option.name: --enforce-time-limit
tip: Enforce time limit based on test size.

option.name: --exclude-filter
tip: Exclude tests that match the given filter pattern.
Accepts the same syntax as --filter.

option.name: --exclude-group
tip: Exclude tests from the specified groups.
Can be used multiple times.
Use a+b to exclude the tests that are in all of the named groups.

option.name: --exclude-source-from-xml-coverage
tip: Exclude the <source> element from the code coverage report in XML format.

option.name: --exclude-testsuite
tip: Exclude tests from the specified test suites.
Separate multiple suite names with commas.

option.name: --extension
tip: Register a test runner extension by its bootstrap class.
Can be used multiple times.

option.name: --fail-on-all-issues
tip: Signal failure using shell exit code when an issue is triggered.

option.name: --fail-on-deprecation
tip: Signal failure using shell exit code when a deprecation was triggered.

option.name: --fail-on-direct-deprecation
tip: Signal failure using shell exit code when a deprecation was triggered in third-party code called from first-party code.

option.name: --fail-on-empty-test-suite
tip: Signal failure using shell exit code when no tests were run.

option.name: --fail-on-incomplete
tip: Signal failure using shell exit code when a test was marked incomplete.

option.name: --fail-on-indirect-deprecation
tip: Signal failure using shell exit code when a deprecation was triggered in third-party code called from third-party code.

option.name: --fail-on-notice
tip: Signal failure using shell exit code when a notice was triggered.

option.name: --fail-on-phpunit-deprecation
tip: Signal failure using shell exit code when a PHPUnit deprecation was triggered.

option.name: --fail-on-phpunit-notice
tip: Signal failure using shell exit code when a PHPUnit notice was triggered.

option.name: --fail-on-phpunit-warning
tip: Signal failure using shell exit code when a PHPUnit warning was triggered.

option.name: --fail-on-risky
tip: Signal failure using shell exit code when a test was considered risky.

option.name: --fail-on-self-deprecation
tip: Signal failure using shell exit code when a deprecation was triggered in first-party code.

option.name: --fail-on-skipped
tip: Signal failure using shell exit code when a test was skipped.

option.name: --fail-on-warning
tip: Signal failure using shell exit code when a warning was triggered.

option.name: --filter
tip: Filter which tests to run by name.
Accepts a PCRE pattern or shortcut selectors such as ClassName::method and method#3.

option.name: --generate-baseline
tip: Generate a baseline file that records the issues that currently exist.

option.name: --generate-configuration
tip: Generate a configuration file with suggested settings.
This starts an interactive wizard.

option.name: --globals-backup
tip: Back up and restore $GLOBALS for each test.

option.name: --group
tip: Only run tests from the specified groups.
Can be used multiple times.
Use a+b to select the tests that are in all of the named groups.

option.name: --help
tip: Print this usage information and exit.

option.name: --ignore-baseline
tip: Do not use the configured baseline file.

option.name: --ignore-dependencies
tip: Do not reorder tests to resolve dependencies between them.

option.name: --include-git-information
tip: Include Git information in supported formats.

option.name: --include-path
tip: Prepend PHP's include_path with the given paths.
Separate multiple paths with the platform's path separator.

option.name: --list-groups
tip: List available test groups.

option.name: --list-suites
tip: List available test suites.

option.name: --list-test-files
tip: List available test files.

option.name: --list-test-ids
tip: List available tests as test IDs.

option.name: --list-tests
tip: List available tests.

option.name: --list-tests-xml
tip: List the available tests in XML format to the given file.

option.name: --log-events-text
tip: Stream all test runner events as plain text to a file.

option.name: --log-events-verbose-text
tip: Stream all test runner events as plain text with extended information to a file.

option.name: --log-junit
tip: Write the test results in JUnit XML format to a file.

option.name: --log-otr
tip: Write the test results in Open Test Reporting XML format to a file.

option.name: --log-teamcity
tip: Write the test results in TeamCity format to a file.

option.name: --manifest
tip: Print the Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) of the PHAR in plain-text format, then exit.
Only available when PHPUnit runs from a PHAR.

option.name: --migrate-configuration
tip: Migrate a configuration file to the current format.

option.name: --no-configuration
tip: Ignore the default configuration file (phpunit.xml).

option.name: --no-coverage
tip: Ignore the code coverage reporting configured in the XML configuration file.

option.name: --no-extensions
tip: Do not register any test runner extensions.

option.name: --no-logging
tip: Ignore the logging configured in the XML configuration file.

option.name: --no-output
tip: Disable all output.

option.name: --no-progress
tip: Disable output of test execution progress.

option.name: --no-results
tip: Disable output of test results.

option.name: --only-summary-for-coverage-text
tip: Option for code coverage report in text format: only show summary.

option.name: --order-by
tip: Run the tests in the order given by the pipeline stages.
Possible values: default, defects, duration-ascending, duration-descending, modified-ascending, modified-descending, random, reverse, size-ascending, size-descending.
depends, no-depends, duration and size are still accepted but deprecated.

option.name: --path-coverage
tip: Report path coverage in addition to line/branch coverage.

option.name: --process-isolation
tip: Run each test in a separate PHP process.

option.name: --random-order
tip: Alias for "--order-by random".

option.name: --random-order-seed
tip: Use the specified random seed when running tests in random order.

option.name: --record-test-run-history
tip: Record test run history.

option.name: --repeat
tip: Run each test N times, stopping at the first failure.

option.name: --require-coverage-contribution
tip: Be strict about tests that do not contribute to code coverage.

option.name: --requires-php-extension
tip: Only run tests that require the given PHP extension.
Can be used multiple times.

option.name: --resolve-dependencies
tip: Reorder tests to resolve dependencies between them.
This is the default.

option.name: --retry
tip: Attempt each test up to N times, stopping at the first success.

option.name: --reverse-list
tip: Print defects in reverse order.

option.name: --reverse-order
tip: Alias for "--order-by reverse".

option.name: --run-test-id
tip: Only run the single test identified by the given test ID.
Matching is exact, not a pattern.

option.name: --sbom
tip: Print the Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) of the PHAR in CycloneDX XML format, then exit.
Only available when PHPUnit runs from a PHAR.

option.name: --show-uncovered-for-coverage-text
tip: Option for code coverage report in text format: show uncovered files.

option.name: --static-backup
tip: Back up and restore static properties for each test.

option.name: --stderr
tip: Write to STDERR instead of STDOUT.

option.name: --stop-on-defect
tip: Stop after the first (or n-th) error, failure, warning, or risky test.
Without a value, stops after the first occurrence.

option.name: --stop-on-deprecation
tip: Stop after the first (or n-th) test that triggers a deprecation.
Without a value, stops after the first occurrence.

option.name: --stop-on-error
tip: Stop after the first (or n-th) error.
Without a value, stops after the first occurrence.

option.name: --stop-on-failure
tip: Stop after the first (or n-th) failure.
Without a value, stops after the first occurrence.

option.name: --stop-on-incomplete
tip: Stop after the first (or n-th) incomplete test.
Without a value, stops after the first occurrence.

option.name: --stop-on-notice
tip: Stop after the first (or n-th) test that triggers a notice.
Without a value, stops after the first occurrence.

option.name: --stop-on-risky
tip: Stop after the first (or n-th) risky test.
Without a value, stops after the first occurrence.

option.name: --stop-on-skipped
tip: Stop after the first (or n-th) skipped test.
Without a value, stops after the first occurrence.

option.name: --stop-on-warning
tip: Stop after the first (or n-th) warning.
Without a value, stops after the first occurrence.

option.name: --strict-coverage
tip: Be strict about code coverage metadata.

option.name: --strict-global-state
tip: Be strict about changes to global state.

option.name: --teamcity
tip: Replace the default progress and result output with TeamCity format.

option.name: --test-files-file
tip: Only run the test files listed in the given file, one file per line.

option.name: --test-id-filter-file
tip: Only run the tests listed by test ID in the given file, one test ID per line.

option.name: --test-suffix
tip: Only search for tests in files with the specified suffixes.
Default: Test.php,.phpt.
Can be used multiple times.

option.name: --testdox
tip: Replace the default result output with TestDox format.

option.name: --testdox-html
tip: Write the test results in TestDox format (HTML) to a file.

option.name: --testdox-summary
tip: Repeat TestDox output for tests with errors, failures, or issues.

option.name: --testdox-text
tip: Write the test results in TestDox format (plain text) to a file.

option.name: --testsuite
tip: Only run tests from the specified test suites.
Separate multiple suite names with commas.

option.name: --timeout
tip: Stop the test run after the given number of seconds of wall-clock time for the entire run.

option.name: --use-baseline
tip: Use a baseline file to ignore the issues it records.

option.name: --uses
tip: Only run tests that declare they intend to use the given class or function.
Can be used multiple times.

option.name: --validate-configuration
tip: Validate the XML configuration file.

option.name: --version
tip: Print the version and exit.

option.name: --warm-coverage-cache
tip: Warm the static analysis cache.

option.name: --warn-when-php-is-not-configured-for-development
tip: Trigger a test runner warning when PHP is not configured for development.

option.name: --with-telemetry
tip: Include telemetry information in the debugging output.

option.name: --without-class-view
tip: Render code coverage report in HTML format without class view.

option.name: --without-file-view
tip: Render code coverage report in HTML format without file view.

option.name: -d
tip: Set a php.ini value for the test run.
Omit the value to set it to 1.
Can be used multiple times.
